arxiv-2212-12438.title: Chaos analysis in the un-perturbed system for Quintic Duffing equation yabous ,khenchela, Lycee Mourri toufana
arxiv-2212-12438.creator: Zeraoulia Rafik, Alvaro humberto Salas
arxiv-2212-12438.description: Abstract In this paper we have investigated the driven cubic-quintic Duffing equation. Using the Melnikov analysis technique, we are able to predict the number of limit cycles around the equilibrium and to develop a theoretical approach to chaos suppression in damped driven systems. The analytical solution and the bifurcation of limit cycles of the investigated system have been studied.

arxiv-2305-01242.title: Recent advances in the SISSO method and their implementation in the SISSO++ code
arxiv-2305-01242.creator: Thomas A. R. Purcell, Matthias Scheffler, Luca M. Ghiringhelli
arxiv-2305-01242.description: Abstract Accurate and explainable artificial-intelligence (AI) models are promising tools for the acceleration of the discovery of new materials, ore new applications for existing materials. Recently, symbolic regression has become an increasingly popular tool for explainable AI because it yields models that are relatively simple analytical descriptions of target properties.

arxiv-2305-18468.title: Characteristics of nonequilibrium evolution near the phase boundary
arxiv-2305-18468.creator: Xiaobing Li, Yuming Zhong, Ranran Guo, Mingmei Xu, Yu Zhou, Jinghua Fu, Yuanfang Wu
arxiv-2305-18468.description: Abstract Using the single-spin flipping dynamics, we study the nonequilibrium evolution near the entire phase boundary of the 3D Ising model, and find that the average of relaxation time (RT) near the first-order phase transition line (1st-PTL) is significantly larger than that near the critical point (CP).

arxiv-2402-13779.title: Contextual Molecule Representation Learning from Chemical Reaction Knowledge
arxiv-2402-13779.creator: Han Tang ∗, Shikun Feng ∗, Bicheng Lin, Yuyan Ni, Jingjing Liu, Wei-Ying Ma, Yanyan Lan
arxiv-2402-13779.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Han Tang ∗, Shikun Feng ∗, Bicheng Lin, Yuyan Ni, Jingjing Liu, Wei-Ying Ma, Yanyan Lan. In recent years, self-supervised learning has emerged as a powerful tool to harness abundant unlabelled data for representation learning and has been broadly adopted in diverse areas. However, when applied to molecular representation learning (MRL), prevailing techniques such as masked sub-unit reconstruction often fall short, due to the high degree of freedom in the possible combinations of atoms within molecules, which brings insurmountable complexity to the masking-reconstruction paradigm.

arxiv-2404-09257.title: Mixing is easy: New insights for cosmochemical evolution from pre-stellar core collapse
arxiv-2404-09257.creator: Asmita Bhandare ,, Benoît Commerçon, Guillaume Laibe, Mario Flock, Rolf Kuiper, Thomas Henning, Andrea Mignone, Gabriel-Dominique Marleau
arxiv-2404-09257.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Asmita Bhandare ,, Benoît Commerçon, Guillaume Laibe, Mario Flock, Rolf Kuiper, Thomas Henning, Andrea Mignone, Gabriel-Dominique Marleau. Signposts of early planet formation are ubiquitous in substructured young discs. Dense, hot, and high-pressure regions that formed during the gravitational collapse process, integral to star formation, facilitate dynamical mixing of dust within the protostellar disc. This provides an incentive to constrain the role of gas and dust interaction and resolve potential zones of dust concentration during star and disc formation stages.

arxiv-2404-16204.title: Entanglement-Based Artificial Topology: Neighboring Remote Network Nodes Thanks: The authors are with the Quantum Internet Research Group, University of Naples Federico II, Naples, NA 80125, Italy Thanks: CORRESPONDING AUTHOR: Angela Sara Cacciapuoti (e-mail: angelasara.cacciapuoti@unina.it). Thanks
arxiv-2404-16204.creator: Si-Yi Chen, Jessica Illiano, Angela Sara Cacciapuoti
arxiv-2404-16204.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Si-Yi Chen, Jessica Illiano, Angela Sara Cacciapuoti. Entanglement is unanimously recognized as the key communication resource of the Quantum Internet. Thus, the possibility of implementing unparalleled network functionalities by exploiting entanglement is gaining huge attention. However, the research efforts in this context are mainly focused on bipartite entanglement , often discarding the wide unexplored classes of entanglement shared among more than two parties, known as multipartite entanglement . In this paper, we aim at exploiting multipartite entanglement as inter-network resource .

arxiv-2409-16784.title: World Model-based Perception for Visual Legged Locomotion
arxiv-2409-16784.creator: Hang Lai, Jiahang Cao, Jiafeng Xu, Hongtao Wu, Yunfeng Lin, Tao Kong, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang
arxiv-2409-16784.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hang Lai, Jiahang Cao, Jiafeng Xu, Hongtao Wu, Yunfeng Lin, Tao Kong, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang. Legged locomotion over various terrains is challenging and requires precise perception of the robot and its surroundings from both proprioception and vision. However, learning directly from high-dimensional visual input is often data-inefficient and intricate. To address this issue, traditional methods attempt to learn a teacher policy with access to privileged information first and then learn a student policy to imitate the teacher’s behavior with visual input.

pmc-10597068.title: Socioeconomic inequalities in noncommunicable diseases in Portugal: an analysis of three decades
pmc-10597068.creator: M Martins Teixeira, A Varela, J V Santos, J Perelman, T Leão
pmc-10597068.description: BackgroundLeast favored people experience poorer health than those with higher socioeconomic (SE) status. These inequalities are mainly due to disparities in noncommunicable diseases (NCD). Over the last decades, Portugal experienced important SE challenges, including the recession, making it fundamental to assess how health inequalities have been affected.

pmc-10631638.title: Developing a patient flow visualization and prediction model using aggregated data for a healthcare network cluster in Southwest Ethiopia
pmc-10631638.creator: Balew Ayalew Kassie, Geletaw Sahle Tegenaw, Laura Sbaffi, Young-Gab Kim, Laura Sbaffi, Young-Gab Kim
pmc-10631638.description: A health information system has been created to gather, aggregate, analyze, interpret, and utilize data collected from diverse sources. In Ethiopia, the most popular digital tools are the Electronic Community Health Information System and the District Health Information System. However, these systems lack capabilities like real-time interactive visualization and a data-driven engine for evidence-based insights.

pmc-11381899.title: Mental health in mothers and fathers of children with chronic disorders
pmc-11381899.creator: Erica Zahl, Agnes M Willemen, Trude Fredriksen, Solveig M Kirchhofer, Torun M Vatne, Stian Orm, Matteo Botta, Caitlin Prentice, Krister W Fjermestad
pmc-11381899.description: ObjectiveThis study applied the Family Systems Illness Model to examine how child disorder severity influences mental health in mothers and fathers of children with chronic (mainly developmental) disorders (CD).MethodsWe measured parental mental health and perceived child disorder severity among 204 mothers and 125 fathers of 220 children with CD and compared the mental health scores with norms.

pmc-11668475.title: Incidental diagnosis of subcutaneous filariasis with an unusual presentation in a non-endemic area—Need to worry?
pmc-11668475.creator: Shivanee Sharma, Pooja S. Kala, Avneesh Malviya, Anjali Lakhani, Naveen Chandra
pmc-11668475.description: We report an interesting case of Bancroftian filariasis diagnosed on fine needle aspiration cytology in a young female hailing from a non-endemic hilly area of India, who presented with a subcutaneous swelling on the left forearm. This is an unusual extra-lymphatic site to harbor filarial infestation and the cytology smears showed adult worms, eggs, and microfilariae of Wuchereria bancrofti.

pmc-12855184.title: Epitaxial growth of wafer-scale 2D superconductor single crystals by metal-organic chemical vapor deposition
pmc-12855184.creator: Zhenyu Wang, Tan Luo, Liu Shi, Xin Chen, Jing Zhang, Zhiwei Yao, Jianzhou Lu, Yiou Huang, Zheng Zhu, Le Zheng, Mengjiao Li, Andras Kis, Lei Zhang, Jianhua Zhang
pmc-12855184.description: Metallic two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are garnering significant attention for their ability to enhance device performance when used as 2D contacts with semiconducting 2D materials, as well as for their intriguing low-temperature properties, including superconductivity, magnetism, and charge density waves (CDWs).
